POSTFORM
An offline post formatter for LinkedIn and X

1. Double-click Postform.html to open it in your browser.
2. Paste your Markdown or formatted draft into the left-hand box.
   It appears as formatted, editable text without Markdown symbols.
3. Select text and click B for bold or I for italics. You can also
   edit the wording, add lists, and add or edit links. The right-hand
   Unicode preview updates live.
4. Click Copy post, then paste the whole post into LinkedIn or X.

No installation, internet connection, or account is needed.

Bold letters and numbers convert together. Italics, links, emojis,
and paragraph spacing are handled in the same step. The app starts
with an empty draft. Use Options > Try an example for a quick demo.

EDITING
Select text, then click B or I to apply or remove formatting.
Ctrl+B and Ctrl+I work too (Command+B / Command+I on Mac).
Use Clear style (T× on small screens) to remove bold and italics.
The list button creates a bullet list. The link button adds a link;
click an existing link in your draft to edit its text or URL.
Ctrl+Z (Command+Z on Mac) undoes edits in the visual editor.

OPTIONS
Open Options below the editor for spacing, font, and link controls.
Download actions and the example are here too.

SPACING
Social: adds blank lines between source lines, keeping lists together.
Roomy: also adds blank lines between list items.
Keep my line breaks: preserves the layout you pasted.

LINKS
Label + URL keeps the destination visible in the post.
URL on a new line puts destinations below their labels.
Label only removes destinations from the copied text.

COPYING
Click Copy post, or use Ctrl+Enter (Command+Enter on Mac).
If your browser blocks copying, the post will be selected so
you can copy it using Ctrl+C (Command+C on Mac).

SAVE
Options > Save post as .txt exports a UTF-8 text file.
Options > Download app creates another portable HTML copy.
Your draft and settings are stored locally in this browser when
local storage is available. Clear the draft to remove it.

NOTES
Unicode styling supports basic Latin letters and bold digits.
Italic-only numbers remain normal; bold italic numbers are bold.
URLs, email addresses, @mentions, and hashtags stay usable.
Use Plain text to remove formatting. Styled characters may be
read differently by assistive technology; use plain text when needed.
The counter measures Unicode code points; platform counters differ.
This tool formats posts. It does not publish them or split threads.
